name: lunexpc-control
description: Private OAuth2/PKCE connection to LunexPCControl read-only Windows desktop tools on your VPS.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your own LunexPCControl VPS for read-only Windows screenshot and control-status tools. No shell, mouse, keyboard, file access or unattended video viewing in Alpha 0.1.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use LunexPCControl to check whether my Windows desktop is reachable and show a screenshot.
